parse_tao_bench_output: parse TAO benchmark stdout to extract server QPS and client metrics into a metrics dictionary
create_server_snapshot: create a TaoBenchServerSnapshot from a benchmark output line to parse fast_qps, hit_rate, and slow_qps values
generate_server_csv: generate a CSV file of server snapshots with columns for total_qps, fast_qps, hit_rate, and is_oom
process_server_snapshots: process server snapshots to calculate average fast_qps and slow_qps from valid data points above minimum hit rate
get_snapshot_value: get a specific metric value from a TaoBenchServerSnapshot by key name with a default of zero
